title: The Effects of Phosphorylation on the Structure and Function of Motif A, an Intrinsically Disordered Region within SIRT1.
authors: Richter, Sabrina M; Bui, Hoang-Long; Chen, Addison; Tannous, Chloe; Butler, Benjamin R; Bennett, Sophia D; Nguyen, Samson Quang-Anh; Prado, Justin; Nhan, Ryan; Mohamed, Ayan; DuBois, Isaac A; Tadros, Emile; Thai, Nhu Tam; Lima Guan, Selina; Peralta, Carla Marie; Kwong, Andy; Hawk, Laura M L; Grazioli, Gianmarc; Wang, Ningkun
one_liner_zh: 该研究结合实验与分子动力学模拟，探究磷酸化修饰对SIRT1无序N端区域motif A结构及对SIRT1活性的调控机制，虽未直接涉及PPI或相分离，但聚焦IDR构象变化的功能影响，方法可迁移至IDR介导互作机制建模。
abstract: The NAD+-dependent deacetylase sirtuin-1 (SIRT1) is known to elicit cellular defenses against aging, cancer, and other aberrant pathologies. Previous studies have identified an intrinsically disordered region of SIRT1 comprised of N-terminal residues 1-52, herein referred to as motif A, which activates SIRT1 activity, likely through intramolecular interactions. Additionally, phosphorylation of N-terminal residues Ser27 and Ser47 has been shown to be important for regulating SIRT1 activity and stability. The lack of in vitro characterization of these effects hampers our further understanding of the role of motif A in SIRT1 regulation. In this study, we elucidate the role phosphorylation plays in motif A's structure as well as its regulatory effects on SIRT1 activity against Ac-p65. We find that a phosphomimetic mutation at Ser27 significantly increases the activation effect of motif A toward SIRT1. This result is supported by molecular dynamics simulations of the phosphomimetics, which reveal stabilization of different transient structures for motif A depending on whether Ser27 and Ser47 have been modified. A key finding suggested by this study is that phosphorylation of S27 appears to activate SIRT1 by causing motif A, which is intrinsically disordered in the WT, to become more rigid. This conclusion is based on both the experimental findings and simulation results. While more experiments are necessary to confirm the MD simulation results, these findings still bring us a step closer to understanding SIRT1 regulation, specifically the role played by phosphorylation within the N-terminal disordered region.
abstract_zh: NAD+依赖性去乙酰化酶sirtuin-1（SIRT1）已知能引发细胞防御机制，对抗衰老、癌症及其他异常病理状态。先前的研究已识别出SIRT1的一个内在无序区域，由N端残基1-52组成，本文中称为基序A，该区域可能通过分子内相互作用激活SIRT1活性。此外，N端残基Ser27和Ser47的磷酸化已被证明对调节SIRT1活性和稳定性至关重要。缺乏对这些效应的体外表征，阻碍了我们进一步理解基序A在SIRT1调控中的作用。在本研究中，我们阐明了磷酸化在基序A结构中的作用及其对SIRT1针对Ac-p65活性的调节效应。我们发现，在Ser27位点的磷酸化模拟突变显著增强了基序A对SIRT1的激活作用。这一结果得到了磷酸化模拟物分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟的支持，模拟显示，根据Ser27和Ser47是否被修饰，基序A的不同瞬态结构得以稳定。本研究提出的一个关键发现是，S27的磷酸化似乎通过使基序A（在野生型中为内在无序）变得更加刚性来激活SIRT1。这一结论基于实验发现和模拟结果。虽然需要更多实验来确认分子动力学模拟结果，但这些发现仍使我们更接近理解SIRT1调控，特别是N端无序区域内磷酸化所扮演的角色。
